name: bizblock-business
description: Run your BizBlock business: schedule, clients, reports, bookings, staff hours and time off.

interface.longDescription:
BizBlock for Business connects your BizBlock account so you can run your salon, barbershop, spa, or yoga, Pilates or fitness studio by asking.

See the schedule for any day or week, find clients, and check revenue and booking reports. Look up services, locations, opening hours and who works where.

Book, move or cancel appointments and mark them completed or no-show; open times follow each location's services, staff and hours. Change a team member's weekly hours or give them time off; bookings in that time are listed so you can move them.

You're asked before every change. Clients get the usual emails, and the assigned team member and admins are emailed too.

Sign in on bizblock.io with your BizBlock account and approve; you get the same access you have in the dashboard. It can't charge cards or change other settings. Requires a BizBlock account.
defaultPrompt: What does my day look like tomorrow?

positive.prompt: What does Lumen's schedule look like next Tuesday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists that day's appointments with times, clients, services and team members

positive.prompt: Who's free for a women's haircut next Wednesday afternoon?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open times, each with the team members free then

positive.prompt: Book Review Client, review@example.com, at the first of those times with Maya
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then returns the booking id and time

positive.prompt: Move that booking an hour later, then cancel it
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before each change; the booking is moved, then cancelled

positive.prompt: Give Theo next Friday off for training, then remove it
positive.expected_behavior: Adds all-day time off (listing any bookings in that time), then removes it

negative.prompt: Charge the client's card for their last visit
negative.expected_behavior: No tool charges cards; explains it can't take payments

negative.description: Business the user doesn't belong to
negative.prompt: Show me the schedule for business 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
negative.expected_behavior: The API refuses because the user isn't a member; nothing is returned
Asks for the client, service and time; no booking is made until they are given and confirmed

publication.release_notes: First release: schedule, clients, reports, services, locations and team; find open times; create, reschedule and cancel bookings and mark them completed or no-show; set staff hours and time off.
